name: Gemini EW
summary: Gemini EW is a legacy active-stereo depth camera documented by Orbbec for robot collision avoidance and environmental perception. It provides depth and RGB sensing with onboard processing and USB connectivity. Current commercial availability and its original launch date have not been confirmed.
